findings.description: Gate and host-emitter inventories generated but omitted from license gate; workflow wiring repaired with denied-dependency regressions.
CLI help incorrectly called all commands non-mutating; now identifies initializer local writes and monitored-runtime boundary.

Initializer no-clobber creation protects final filenames and checks parent symlinks before creation; it does not pin parent directories against hostile concurrent rename. Local filesystem administration remains trusted.
Strong routing/TLS requirements apply only when evidence_source_binding configured; generic custom Collector configurations need separate qualification.
